## Appearance

Mrs. Allan possesses eyes that are clear, bright, and true. Her countenance is also marked by sweet and sudden dimples.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P27](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0027)_

## Personality

Allan is a cheerful young man known for his frank demeanor and high ideals, making him well-liked by people of all ages. He possesses a strong talent for preaching magnificent sermons, an ability that continues to improve over time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P3](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0003)_

## History

Mrs. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) five years prior as the minister's bride, having been bad at geometry and a mischievous girl who frequently got into scrapes. During a tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she kindly comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl accidentally served her a cake flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. She later supported [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) following Matthew's sudden death and funeral, and she eventually walked home with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from the graveyard, offering her encouraging advice on teaching, ideals, and friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is a close friend and trusted mentor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship got off to a rocky start when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally poisoned a cake served to her with anodyne liniment, but Mrs. Allan treated the mistake with kindness and comforted the mortified girl. Over time, Mrs. Allan provides steady emotional support and thoughtful council to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), standing by her through Matthew's death and later offering encouragement regarding Anne's teaching career, ideals, and personal growth.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), +15 more_
